system.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency.
You gain the Keep Measure ◆ action.
Keep Measure ◆ (stance)
Requirements You are wielding a hafted weapon.
While in this stance: the first time each round an enemy moves from outside your Reach into it, you may Step 3 feet directly away as a free action after that movement finishes; if that movement keeps the enemy within your Reach, it does not trigger reactions from that enemy. Every talent here requires this.
